## `invert.classify`

Fractions of the frame per inversion class.

- Owner: CHB-003
- On: Image (film-dyes) → Value
- Class: measure; binding: stock
- Implementation: mock

| Argument | Type | Unit | Range | Usual | Default | Recipe path | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sigma` | vec3 | D | [0, 0.2] |  | `[0.0043,0.0033,0.0057]` |  | Scanner noise σ per channel in D (from scan.noise; default: Gold 200 at 640 px). |

Returns:

- `reachable`: number (fraction) — fraction solved within tolerance
- `blank`: number (fraction) — fraction indistinguishable from blank film
- `belowBase`: number (fraction) — fraction below the base
- `unreachable`: number (fraction) — fraction out of the stock gamut
